The second one is testing on its [desktop](bc-1708c3c2-1d5c-565b-8e82-aa6e9b671cd1#desktop) if you want to watch; the release worker is idle at https://cursor.com/agents/bc-5e7d0f3a-0b7e-4c2a-9d0e-2f4a6b8c1d3e until both merge.

The plan is in `/cursor/stores/bc-bae107cb-2562-40b2-b814-4f8eca874668/docs/project-context.md`, and its [spec section](docs/spec.md) is relative to it.
